purpose: Construct genuine visibility-opportunity states, measure the behavior-oracle view envelope, and derive view-value hypotheses before changing the visibility definition.
research_questions: Does a large physically valid candidate bank contain views that improve closed-loop behavior over canonical?
Which observation and geometry properties distinguish behavior-positive views within the same task state?
Can a selector learned on disjoint source demonstrations recover the behavior-oracle headroom on untouched states?

legacy_a97.reason: Outcomes have already been inspected and each state-view has only one rollout.

new_discovery.source_demonstrations: disjoint from calibration and final test

new_calibration.source_demonstrations: disjoint from discovery and final test

new_final_test.source_demonstrations: untouched until all definitions and thresholds are frozen

natural_screen.selection: Sample multiple stages and retain states with measurable canonical-to-candidate evidence variation without using closed-loop test outcomes.

requirements: same physics state across camera conditions
canonical or blind view hides a task-relevant entity or region
matched-control pose has similar displacement without evidence gain

candidate_banks.diagnostic_extremes: look-away + crossed orbit + all-camera blackout; evaluation-only negative controls
candidate_banks.constructed_reveal_pairs: task-specific reveal and displacement-matched control poses

visibility_policy.primary_v1_frozen: equal mean visible-pixel fraction over frozen task entities and deployed camera channels
visibility_policy.rule: Do not replace the primary definition until an alternative wins source-group cross-validation and untouched calibration.

behavior_value.stable_label: mean over at least three shared policy-noise seeds
behavior_value.pairing: All views for one state share physics, task, controller, horizon, and policy-noise seeds.

selection_baselines: global fixed pose selected on discovery

analysis.ranking_unit: candidate views within the same physical state

gates.candidate_headroom: Oracle-at-bank improves over canonical by at least 15 percentage points on source-group macro success.
gates.repeatability: Behavior-positive views remain positive across at least three shared policy-noise seeds.
gates.information_specificity: Reveal outperforms a displacement-matched control, not only canonical.
gates.selector_viability: A non-oracle selector beats random and a discovery-selected global fixed pose on untouched calibration sources.
gates.final_test: Definitions, shortlist budget, and selector are frozen before final-test outcomes are generated.
